content: Yeisuw ikit vayuwein
Wankuyeim, Sa̱bat ikous, vinay asteitoun igimweles tagon binawes kid biptumis Yeisuw won. Tasiyas vinen-Magdal yagan Meliy, valeyin Yemes inan, sisiy Salom.
Sa̱bat ikous, kweivaw yam, walalayis ikanakons inounas, bilakwanes kid alawag; ka̱las bo neipel.
Illivans sisiyas, ilansa, “Kal biyatipin dakul towen nisilbwed wadon leg va̱gan bitasiws?”
Ilivans ma̱wan mo itamnawes mites, ikines nanawan bo iyatpin nises wadadan leg; singay avakaein dakul towen.
Iweis tasiyas, isiws wanuwan alawag ikines toubwat teitan nisin waska̱tay, anakweim pwapwa̱kaw. Ikines mo ivag aspwa̱yat.
Mtowen taw idibakes, ilana, “Awoum beivag amipwa̱yat. Kunineivs gum-Nasalet Yeisuw, neimat waklos. Bo ikit. Bo nein. Kukines nakabmasis makaw-wan.
“Kuneis kudibakes navamuls sisiy Pita, kulansa, ‘Bo bimgwayeimiy bein waGaliliy, kuneis waGaliliy mo bukukines, ma̱wan nidibakeimiy.’”
Isaps tasiyas, isawls, ilisawes alawag, itatat wous, singay isom ninous. Nag ikamteles teitan gamag waseg, peinan aspwa̱yat.
Vinen-Magdal ikin
[Sa̱bat ikous, iyam nen bo ikit Yeisuw, wanmugwana isap waseg vinen-Magdal, yagan Meliy, kweiboug nikayeb yeiluw teinim teiy niyagages. Mana̱wen ikin, inoun, inekes Yeisuw nagamag igawa nivva̱lams.
Meliy ilana, “Bo akin Yeisuw sona mwamovan nises.” Tasiyas iliganes, tage nag isimounids.
Asteiy ikines
Wankuyeim nagamag asteiy ikines Yeisuw ankakin kweitan, igaw inounas bineis wanawoud. Ikines, iyums idibakes sisiyas, tage nag isimounids.
Navamuls bo isekes siwotet
Wankuyeim navamul sinwatan tatanok, ikamkwams, mo inekes. Ikines, ilana, “Keikay gamag, takakons yakamiy. Gamag mwasanin bo ikineigs, idibakeimiy, tage nag kusimounids.”

Ilana, “Kuneis vena babaw, kugeiguys, kusekes livan bwanabwein, gamag tatanok tatanok wasigeis. Kukin kal bisimounid bibaptays mo Yowbad bikatinob; kukin gog nag, Yowbad mo bikamtan. Tasiyas bisimounids mo biwotets tawtoun; yagag waseg bikayabes bwagaw; kaeig kweitan kweitan billivans; mwatet biyousis wanimes; o pwa̱tuw beimoums nag biyagages; bisenas nimes takatouns wawous mo beibweins.”
Imwen in walba̱lab
SiGuyaw mtowen siney illivans ikous, mo imwen in walba̱lab, isin Yowbad wanaka̱tay.
Tasiyas gog mo ineis ven babaw igeiguys, siGuyaw ilabes, siwotet mo itawtoun singay. Gamag ikines tawtoun siwotet mo isimounids asilivan waseg.]
